deadline.intake: Kyoto iUP, October 2026 enrollment (6-month prep course, undergraduate April 2027)

tuition.note: Annual undergraduate tuition for iUP (admission fee 282,000 JPY); as of 1 July 2025. No IELTS minimum set; typical successful IELTS 6.5

requirement.text: Must be non-Japanese and have completed or expect to complete 12 years of schooling outside Japan by 30 Sept 2026, and submit an accepted English test (e.g. IELTS, TOEFL) taken after 1 Nov 2023.
